title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
title_zh: VibeEdit: 画布指令引导的图像编辑

paragraphs.en: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit , follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source–target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在文本引导的图像编辑中，描述期望的变化通常很简单，但确定目标物体或区域可能很繁琐，尤其是当多个物体看起来相似时。 我们引入了一种新的图像编辑界面，允许用户直接在图像上放置空间标记和可选的简短注释。 这些标注共同构成了一幅画布指令，明确了需要编辑的位置和要更改的内容。 我们的编辑器 VibeEdit 遵循这些指令，无需单独的文本提示即可执行物体添加、移除、替换、属性修改和移动操作。 我们构建了 155 万个源-目标编辑对，其中包含物体掩码和结构化编辑描述，并在训练期间从中生成画布指令。 我们通过层解耦条件机制对 Qwen-Image-Edit 进行了适配，该机制可分别编码源图像和画布指令以进行图像编辑。 我们采用区域加权监督微调来训练模型，随后通过评分标准引导的强化学习，提升编辑完成度、局部编辑质量以及对未编辑区域的保留能力。 我们在一个独立构建并由人工标注的基准数据集上评估了 VibeEdit，该数据集包含 419 个案例，重点测试在相似物体中选择目标的能力。 VibeEdit 的 VLM 评分为 79.9，区域外 PSNR 为 32.8 dB，而我们在评估中得分最高的文本引导基线模型 FireRed 的对应分数为 67.4 和 24.0 dB。

paragraphs.en: Instruction-based image editors translate natural-language requests into image changes ( Brooks et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Black Forest Labs, 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; OpenAI, 2025 ) . For a localized edit, users must specify both what to change and where to apply it. Describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object can require detailed descriptions of its position and surroundings, especially when several objects look alike. Points and brush strokes provide direct spatial control ( Pan et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025c ) , while language expresses the desired change. Combining these complementary cues directly on the image offers a natural way to link an edit to its target.
paragraphs.zh: 基于指令的图像编辑器可将自然语言请求转化为图像修改（Brooks 等，2023；Wu 等，2025；Team 等，2025；Black Forest Labs，2026；Team 等，2026；Song 等，2026；Liu 等，2025b；OpenAI，2025）。 对于局部修改，用户必须同时说明要修改的内容以及修改的位置。 描述期望的修改通常较为直接，但确定目标对象可能需要对其位置和周围环境进行详细描述，尤其是当多个对象外观相似时。 点选和笔触可提供直接的空間控制（Pan 等，2023；Liu 等，2025c），而语言则用于表达期望的修改。 在图像上直接结合这些互补的提示，为将修改与其目标关联提供了一种自然的方式。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image (Figure 1 ). Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Circles identify objects or regions, scribbles indicate removal, and arrows specify movement. Short notes placed near the marks describe the desired content or attributes. For example, a user can circle a chair and write a new color beside it, or mark an empty region and name an object to add. These marks need not follow precise object boundaries. To support this interface, we develop VibeEdit , an image editor that follows canvas instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了一种新的图像编辑界面，用户可以直接在图像上放置空间标记和可选的简短注释（图 1）。 这些注释共同构成了一幅画布指令，明确了需要编辑的位置和修改的内容。 圆圈用于标识物体或区域，涂鸦表示删除，箭头则指定移动方向。 放置在标记附近的简短注释描述了期望的内容或属性。 例如，用户可以圈出一把椅子并在旁边写下新的颜色，或者标记一个空白区域并命名要添加的物体。 这些标记不必严格遵循物体的边界。 为了支持这一界面，我们开发了 VibeEdit——一款图像编辑器，它能根据画布指令执行物体的添加、删除、替换、属性修改和移动操作，而无需单独的文本提示。

paragraphs.en: Training VibeEdit requires paired examples that connect canvas instructions to the intended edits. We construct a corpus of 1.55 million source–target edit pairs by selecting editable objects and generating edited targets with existing models. Each pair includes object masks and structured edit descriptions. During training, we use these records to render spatial marks and short notes, sampling either editing direction where applicable. We vary stroke shapes, widths, and typefaces, including handwriting and print styles, to expose the model to different annotations for the same edit.
paragraphs.zh: 训练 VibeEdit 需要成对的示例，将画布指令与预期的编辑操作关联起来。 我们通过选择可编辑对象，并使用现有模型生成编辑后的目标，构建了一个包含 155 万个源-目标编辑对的语料库。 每对示例都包含对象掩码和结构化的编辑描述。 在训练过程中，我们利用这些记录来渲染空间标记和简短注释，并在适用时采样不同的编辑方向。 我们通过变化笔触形状、宽度和字体类型（包括手写体和印刷体风格），使模型能够接触到针对同一编辑的不同标注方式。

paragraphs.en: Following canvas instructions requires the editor to interpret annotations in context without reproducing them in the output. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025 ) with layer-decoupled conditioning: the vision–language encoder interprets the annotated image, while the generative pathway separately encodes the source image and canvas annotations. This design provides spatial guidance while retaining a clean source reference. Because most pixels remain unchanged in a localized edit, we use region-weighted supervised fine-tuning to emphasize the edit region and annotation removal while retaining supervision over the full image. A visually plausible result can still target the wrong object or alter unrelated content. We therefore refine the editor with rubric-guided reinforcement learning ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , using rewards for edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循画布指令要求编辑者在理解上下文中解释标注，而无需在输出中重复呈现这些标注。 我们对 Qwen-Image-Edit（Wu 等，2025）进行了改进，采用分层解耦的条件机制：视觉语言编码器负责解释带标注的图像，而生成路径则分别对源图像和画布标注进行编码。 这种设计在提供空间指引的同时，保留了干净的源图像参考。 由于局部编辑中大多数像素保持不变，我们采用区域加权监督微调方法，以强调编辑区域和标注移除过程，同时保留对整个图像的监督。 即使结果在视觉上看似合理，仍可能针对错误的对象或修改无关内容。 因此，我们通过评分标准引导的强化学习（Feng 等，2025；Zheng 等，2026）对编辑器进行优化，利用编辑完成度、局部编辑质量以及未编辑区域的保留情况来生成奖励。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases. The benchmark emphasizes scenes with similar objects to test whether the editor applies the requested change to the intended instance. We jointly assess edit success, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions, since preserving the source alone does not establish that an edit was completed. VibeEdit achieves an overall VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, outperforming all evaluated baselines on both metrics, even when baselines receive detailed external text instructions specifying the edit target and desired change.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个独立构建、由人工筛选的包含 419 个案例的基准数据集上对 VibeEdit 进行了评估。 该基准数据集重点关注包含相似物体的场景，以测试编辑器是否将所请求的更改应用于目标实例。 我们共同评估了编辑的成功性、局部编辑质量以及对未编辑区域的保留情况，因为仅保留原始内容并不能证明编辑已经完成。 VibeEdit 在 VLM 评分标准上获得了 79.9 分的总分，并在区域外 PSNR 上达到了 32.8 dB，在这两项指标上都优于所有被评估的基线模型，即使这些基线模型获得了详细的外部文本指令来明确编辑目标和期望的更改。

paragraphs.en: Instruction-based image editing. Large-scale text-to-image pretraining supplies the generative prior for modern editors. Recent systems span publicly released HunyuanImage 3.0, Z-Image, and Lens, alongside proprietary Qwen-Image-2.0 and Seedream 4.0, exploring autoregressive modeling, multimodal diffusion, and unified generation and editing ( Cao et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Seedream et al., 2025 ) . Diffusion editors translate language instructions into image transformations. paragraphs.en: Spatial control and visual instructions. Spatial interfaces generally follow three patterns. First, operation-specific methods encode geometric correspondence through handle and target points. DragGAN ( Pan et al., 2023 ) and DragDiffusion ( Shi et al., 2024 ) focus on object movement and deformation. Second, region-guided visual-instruction methods combine image-space cues with separate text. Inter-Edit ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , FineEdit ( Xu et al., 2026a ) , and scribble-guided editing ( Xu et al., 2026b ) use masks, boxes, or scribbles for localization, while VIBE ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) evaluates broader visual cues with textual task instructions. Third, visual-interaction systems structure edit intent through graphical controls. The MagicQuill series ( Liu et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2026b ) explores richer interactions: the original system combines brush modes with an inferred editing prompt, while its successor couples language with layered content, spatial, and color controls. By contrast, VibeEdit combines circles, scribbles, and movement arrows with open-vocabulary handwritten instructions. Rather than using image-space cues only for localization, it also places semantic guidance directly on the canvas across five edit types.
paragraphs.zh: 空间控制与视觉指令。 空间界面通常遵循三种模式。 首先，特定操作的方法通过手柄和目标点编码几何对应关系。 DragGAN（Pan 等人，2023）和 DragDiffusion（Shi 等人，2024）专注于物体的移动与形变。 其次，区域引导的视觉指令方法将图像空间线索与独立的文本相结合。 Inter-Edit（Liu 等人，2026a）、FineEdit（Xu 等人，2026a）和涂鸦引导编辑（Xu 等人，2026b）使用掩码、框或涂鸦进行定位，而 VIBE（Zhang 等人，2026a）则通过文本任务指令评估更广泛的视觉线索。 第三，视觉交互系统通过图形控件组织编辑意图。 MagicQuill 系列（Liu 等人，2025c；Liu 等人，2026b）探索了更丰富的交互：原始系统将画笔模式与推断出的编辑提示相结合，而其后继版本则将语言与分层内容、空间及颜色控制相耦合。 相比之下，VibeEdit 将圆形、涂鸦和移动箭头与开放词汇的手写指令相结合。 它并非仅将图像空间线索用于定位，而是直接在画布上为五种编辑类型提供语义指导。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning for diffusion models. Reward-based post-training aligns diffusion and flow models with visual objectives difficult to express through likelihood training. DDPO ( Black et al., 2024 ) formulates denoising as a sequential decision process. Flow-GRPO and DanceGRPO adapt group-relative policy optimization to diffusion and flow-based generation ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Xue et al., 2025 ) . OP-GRPO ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) improves sample reuse through off-policy trajectory replay. DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) instead optimizes a forward-process objective using positive and implicit negative predictions, without storing full denoising trajectories. For reward design, RubricRL ( Feng et al., 2025 ) decomposes prompt requirements into criteria evaluated independently by a multimodal judge. We adapt forward-process updates and decomposed rewards to localized editing, where edit completion must be balanced with source preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型的强化学习。 基于奖励的后训练方法使扩散模型和流模型与视觉目标对齐，而这些目标难以通过似然训练表达。 DDPO（Black 等，2024）将去噪过程表述为一个序列决策过程。 Flow-GRPO 和 DanceGRPO 将群体相对策略优化方法应用于基于扩散和流的生成模型（Liu 等，2025a；Xue 等，2025）。 OP-GRPO（Zhang 等，2026b）通过离策略轨迹重放提升了样本的重复利用率。 DiffusionNFT（Zheng 等，2026）则通过正向过程目标进行优化，利用正向和隐式负向预测，而无需存储完整的去噪轨迹。 在奖励设计方面，RubricRL（Feng 等，2025）将提示要求分解为多个标准，由多模态评判器独立评估。 我们将正向过程更新和分解后的奖励方法应用于局部化编辑，其中编辑的完整性必须与原始内容的保留性保持平衡。

paragraphs.en: We construct three datasets for VibeEdit across five edit types: a supervised learning corpus for training the editor to follow canvas instructions, an RL set selected by reward variation, and a human-curated benchmark to evaluate instruction following and target selection among similar objects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 VibeEdit 构建了三个数据集，涵盖五种编辑类型：一个用于训练编辑器遵循画布指令的监督学习语料库；一个通过奖励差异选出的强化学习数据集；以及一个由人工整理的基准数据集，用于评估在相似对象中遵循指令和选择目标的能力。

paragraphs.en: We synthesize edit pairs offline and render canvas instructions online during training. Figure 2 shows the overall data construction pipeline. Each stored record contains a source image I I , an edited target I edit I_{\mathrm{edit}} , object masks, and structured edit descriptions. This representation separates the underlying edit from its annotation style, allowing the same pair to support varied canvas instructions. paragraphs.en: Object selection and prompt synthesis. In Figure 2 , Florence-2 ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) generates open-vocabulary object proposals. We discard excessively small or large proposals, assign identifiers to the remaining candidates, and provide the indexed image and optional candidate crops to GPT-5.6-sol ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . paragraphs.en: Addition and removal. We select objects with clean boundaries and backgrounds suitable for reconstruction, avoiding tightly entangled instances and prominent attached shadows or reflections. ObjectClear ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) inpaints the masked region of I I to produce an image without the selected object. The original-to-inpainted direction provides removal supervision; reversing the pair provides addition supervision. Each pair thus supports both operations, with the added object and its context drawn from the same original image. We retain the object’s name and visual description.
paragraphs.zh: 添加与移除。 我们选择边界清晰且背景适合重建的物体，避免紧密纠缠的实例以及明显的附加阴影或反射。 ObjectClear（Zhao 等人，2026b）对 I I 中被掩码的区域进行图像修复，以生成一个不包含所选物体的图像。 从原始图像到修复图像的方向提供了移除监督；将这对图像反转则提供了添加监督。 因此，每对图像都支持这两种操作，其中添加的物体及其上下文均源自同一原始图像。 我们保留该物体的名称和视觉描述。

paragraphs.en: RL data selection by reward variation. We select RL conditions based on reward variation across edits sampled from our base model trained with supervised learning. For each candidate image–canvas instruction pair c = ( I , C ) c=(I,C) , we generate K K offline rollouts, score them with the structured reward defined in Section 4.3 , and compute σ ⁡ ( c ) = Std k = 1 K ⁡ [ R ⁡ ( I ^ k , c ) ] \sigma(c)=\operatorname{Std}_{k=1}^{K}[R(\hat{I}_{k};c)] . Within each edit type, we retain the candidates with the highest σ ⁡ ( c ) \sigma(c) . Selection thus favors reward differences among rollouts of the same condition, which provide the relative training signal for DiffusionNFT, rather than low mean rewards. The resulting RL set contains 3,520 conditions, with 704 for each edit type.

paragraphs.en: Human-curated VibeEdit benchmark. We construct a 419-case benchmark independently of the training corpus, using images manually collected and selected from online sources. The benchmark emphasizes scenes containing multiple objects from the same category or with similar appearances. For each case, human annotators specify the edit region with a mask and describe the intended change. We use these annotations to render spatial marks and short notes as needed, forming the canvas instruction. For comparison with text-instructed baselines, we additionally prepare a detailed external text instruction for each case, specifying the target object’s location within the scene and the requested edit. These baselines receive the source image and external text instruction, while VibeEdit receives the source image and canvas instruction without a separate text prompt. The benchmark tests whether an editor interprets the requested change and applies it to the intended object or region. Per-task counts and external text-instruction lengths are reported in Appendix C.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 人工编选的 VibeEdit 基准测试。 我们独立于训练语料构建了一个包含 419 个案例的基准测试，这些案例使用从在线资源中手动收集并挑选的图片。 该基准测试重点关注包含同一类别或多个外观相似物体的场景。 对于每个案例，人工标注者会通过掩码指定编辑区域，并描述预期的修改内容。 我们利用这些标注信息，在需要时渲染空间标记和简短注释，从而形成画布指令。 为了与文本指令基线模型进行比较，我们还为每个案例额外准备了一份详细的外部文本指令，其中明确了目标物体在场景中的位置以及所需的编辑操作。 这些基线模型接收源图像和外部文本指令，而 VibeEdit 则接收源图像和画布指令，无需单独的文本提示。 该基准测试旨在检验编辑器是否能够理解所需的修改，并将其应用于预期的物体或区域。 各任务的具体数量以及外部文本指令的长度在附录 C.2 中报告。

paragraphs.en: Training. We initialize VibeEdit from Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and train rank-128 LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) adapters on the DiT attention projections and modulation layers. Supervised learning uses aspect-ratio buckets of approximately 1024 2 1024^{2} pixels, a global batch size of 128, and a constant learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} after 500 warmup steps. RL starts from the 12,000-step supervised fine-tuned checkpoint and trains a new rank-128 LoRA adapter at 512 2 512^{2} resolution with the same learning rate. Each condition uses 12 rollouts with eight denoising steps and classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale 1, scored by the fixed GPT-5.4-mini ( OpenAI, 2026b ) judge. We evaluate RL at 220 steps. Both stages use 32 NVIDIA A100 GPUs.

paragraphs.en: Main results. Table 1 shows that all six public baselines achieve higher overall rubric scores with external text instructions than with the canvas-annotated image alone. paragraphs.en: We introduced a new image editing interface in which spatial marks and optional short notes form canvas instructions, specifying where to edit and what to change. We developed VibeEdit to support five editing operations through this interface without a separate text prompt. Using 1.55 million source–target edit pairs, we trained VibeEdit with layer-decoupled conditioning, region-weighted supervised learning, and rubric-guided RL. On an independent, human-curated 419-case benchmark emphasizing target selection among similar objects, VibeEdit outperforms the evaluated baselines in overall VLM rubric score and outside-region PSNR.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了一种新的图像编辑界面，其中空间标记和可选的简短注释共同构成画布指令，明确指定了编辑位置及修改内容。 我们开发了 VibeEdit，使其无需单独的文本提示，即可通过该界面支持五种编辑操作。 我们使用 155 万组源-目标编辑对，结合层解耦条件约束、区域加权监督学习和评分标准引导的强化学习，训练了 VibeEdit。 在一项由人工标注的独立基准测试中（包含 419 个案例，重点考察在相似物体中选择目标的能力），VibeEdit 在整体 VLM 评分标准得分和区域外 PSNR 上均优于所评估的基线模型。

paragraphs.en: Joint and single-task training. Table 6 compares single-task base models with a model trained jointly on all five editing tasks. Joint training improves the VLM rubric score over the corresponding single-task models on addition, attribute modification, and movement, suggesting positive transfer across editing operations. Although removal-only and replacement-only models perform better on their respective tasks, the results support learning multiple editing operations within a shared model.

paragraphs.en: Stored records and direction sampling. Each record stores a source–target image pair, object masks, and structured edit fields. For data sources that support bidirectional sampling, the loader selects either direction with equal probability. Reversing an edit swaps the source and target images and updates the instruction fields accordingly. For addition and removal, this exchanges the object-present and object-absent images. For attribute modification, the original attribute value becomes the new target; for replacement, the original object’s description specifies the replacement. Movement reversal swaps the source and destination masks and reverses the arrow. Both directions share one stored pair.

paragraphs.en: Online rendering. After selecting the edit direction, the loader applies the same crop and resize to both images and their masks. The circle indicates the edit region without tracing the exact object shape. We add operation-specific marks and place text notes near the circles as needed, forming the canvas instruction C C . The same annotations are rendered on the source image I I to form A = I ⊕ C A=I\oplus C and on an RGB ( 128,128,128 ) (128,128,128) background to form C ¯ \bar{C} , ensuring consistent appearance and spatial layout across the vision–language and VAE pathways. The target image I edit I_{\mathrm{edit}} remains free of annotations.

paragraphs.en: Operation-specific instructions. Table 12 summarizes how these circles are combined with operation-specific marks and text notes to express each edit type. paragraphs.en: Rendering variation. We randomly vary the spacing between each circle and the object mask boundary from 0.25 to 0.45 times the mask’s equivalent radius, and sample stroke opacity in [ 0.82 , 1.0 ] [0.82,1.0] . We also vary the circle shape, stroke width, and overlap between the stroke’s start and end points. For text notes, we sample handwriting and print typefaces, adjust font size and line wrapping to the available space, and place the text near the selected region while avoiding overlap where possible. These variations produce different canvas instructions for the same edit pair across training iterations. The annotation alpha mask records the locations of rendered strokes and text and is used to construct M ann M_{\mathrm{ann}} for the region-weighted loss in Section 4.2 .

paragraphs.en: The following boxes present the complete binary rubric used for RL rewards and benchmark evaluation. Each example is assessed using a common set of questions together with questions specific to its edit type.
